» Congestion is less frequent, making

navigate the neighborhood

» Streets and sidewalks are accessible, and
built to ADA standards

» A variety of neighborhood restaurants and
retail outlets offer a diverse array of goods,
services, and family-friendly experiences
» Businesses can receive support and
incentives from public entities to recover
from loss of income

» Trees and vegetation provide shade and
help drain stormwater
» Trails are easily accessible for walking,
hiking and biking

» Wastewater, Water, and Storm Water is
expanded to areas planned for development
» Public art and neighborhood branding
convey a sense of place and beautify the
public realm
» Wayfinding signage draws attention to
neighborhood attractions and guides
visitors
» Regulation of commercial signage ensures
a consistent, physical appearance along the
Boulevard
